newsitem.title: USA: Tribune files $500 mln debt, warrants shelf.
newsitem.headline: Tribune files $500 mln debt, warrants shelf.

text.p: Tribune Co said late Friday it filed a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up $500 million in debt securities and warrants to purchase debt securities.

Net proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes, including capital expenditures, working capital, repayment of long-term and short-term debt, securities repurchase programs and the financing of acquisitions, the company said.
Tribune Company, of Chicago, Ill., is an information, entertainment and education company.
